newsitem.title: USA: U.S. durable goods orders rise 2.3 percent in June.
newsitem.headline: U.S. durable goods orders rise 2.3 percent in June.

text.p: Orders for big-ticket manufactured goods posted their biggest jump in five months in June, reflecting strength across the board in the manufacturing sector, the Commerce Department said on Friday.

New orders for durable goods rose a stronger-than-expected 2.3 percent last month to a record $180.6 billion on a seasonally adjusted basis. They fell a revised 0.4 percent in May. The May decline previously was reported as 0.7 percent.
